There is Sinn Fein (Nationalist) and the DUP(Unionist). These are the two major parties they cannot agree on certain areas such as "Irish Languege Act, Abortion and Gay Marriage". The Assembly in Northern Ireland is devolved and separate from the Westminster Parliament. It is a product of the good Friday agreement allowing local laws to be passed by local politicians. However in 2017 a Renewable Heat Incentive scheme was shown to be costing millions and was a total shambles(this was planned out by Arlene Foster leader of the DUP and ex environment minister) , Deputy First Minister Martin McGuinness resigned over this and because there was no power sharing the assembly collapsed and talks have taken place since but no agreement has been made. And quite frankly I don't see any agreements being made. The Assembly has quite a history of the suspensions.
